turn_text: Let's start off with the caucus. So the caucus was an idea between Congresswoman Alma Adams and I. She represents a community in North Carolina. We wanted to work on black maternal mortality and we decided to give ourselves a name. Within a year, the caucus grew to over 100 members by partisan participation. And so that was the foundation of being able to craft legislation that would have support across the aisle. So, for example, that Medicaid expansion that I talked about yesterday, that's the Helping Moms Act that's led by Robin Kelly. It passed unanimously off the Energy and Commerce Committee. I think that that is an item that will be able to get some full consideration in the Senate. I certainly Republican support over there and hopefully get signed into law, right? We're talking about saving moms lives. It's critically important. We have a bill to serve women veterans. And I introduced that with one of my Republican colleagues on the Veterans Affairs Committee, Mr. Bill Arrakis. And I'm really excited that he has joined us on this piece of legislation. And I certainly think that this is one that would be in good shape to pass out of the House and get over to the Senate and possibly get fired into law this year. But I think it's the mom's matter bill that's Joe Kennedy's bill. that addresses the mental health challenges that moms in the postpartum period base that has bipartisan support, right? And so we look towards those bills that do have the bipartisan support where the coalition is already being built and we're working it on both sides of the aisle. Obviously, we have about six months left in this Congress. And so there's a long list of legislation that we need to work on. But I'm so pleased that maternal mortality continues to be at the forefront of this health care policy agenda where we are able to come together and get things done. And quite frankly, this is an issue that really hadn't risen to the highest levels of congressional agendas in prior congresses and so the fact that we're discussing these this issue identifying these solutions and identifying vehicles to attach these bills into something that really gives me hope.
